source_rule: Implementation must preserve semantic/domain authority; M10 governs authorization; no module may silently absorb another module's business truth.
Follow the current API contract and module authority; do not invent undocumented endpoint identifiers or schemas.
Respect current data/schema authority; do not create a new physical table merely because a work package has a new name; controlled authority is required for SQL/migration changes.
Server-side authorization and applicable RLS are authoritative; UI-hidden controls are not authorization; exact IDs/SQL/runtime proof require evidence.
Mutation UI follows busy → request → server authority → canonical response → reconciliation; client debounce never replaces server idempotency.
Applicable surfaces handle loading, empty, success, validation error, denied, not-found, server error, retry, stale, mutation in progress/failure and duplicate/replay outcomes.
M11 is observation/discovery authority; analytics cannot mutate completion, LP, payment, entitlement, qualification or Award.
Learning Economy/Session/evidence remain M04; provider-neutral Session/adapter isolation; LP provenance; idempotent commercial callbacks; no direct Award mutation.

M14 owns Catalog/Order/Payment Core/Verification/Fulfillment/Promotion/Reconciliation; payment is not entitlement/RBAC/Award; fulfillment is verified/idempotent; reconciliation does not silently auto-remediate.
M04 supplies evidence; M15 owns qualification/Award. Completion/certificate/LP/payment/presentation are not equivalent to Award.
M08 is projection/notification only and cannot create the source event it displays.
M09 is bounded admin/config/audit authority and not a universal business authority/global blocker.
Permission Preset is optional configuration targeted to an existing Role and cannot expand the established role baseline.
Organization membership/context does not silently become permission, ownership or entitlement.
Provider credentials remain server-side; provider-specific SDK/payload details remain behind an adapter boundary.
M03 owns Listing/Refresh lifecycle/action semantics and consumes M14 allowance; MVP search remains PostgreSQL FTS + pg_trgm.
Developer/Project ownership and claims remain distinct; Marketing Kit scope follows authorization; Project does not become Listing authority.
Formula/band/bank configuration remains governed/configurable; configurable parameters are not hard-coded; historical outcomes are preserved where required.
Applicable protected packages test wrong actor/resource/Organization, missing permission, stale membership, direct API bypass and direct DB/RLS bypass.
Separate static, unit, integration, negative/security and runtime verification; runtime PASS requires runtime evidence.
UX protection and server-side idempotency/state/uniqueness are both required where canonical mutation can repeat.
Failures are classified, contained, evidenced and fixed at the correct authority layer; downstream patches cannot hide upstream contract contradictions.
Contract/physical/Owner changes propagate through the authoritative contract first; Owner-level decisions stop engineering until decided.
Meaningful implementation units retain Task→WP→Module→Functional→Technical→API→RBAC/RLS→Schema→Rule/Decision→Dependency→Acceptance→Test Evidence→Residual.
Scope, contracts, tests, negative/security evidence, documentation/traceability, checkpoint and applicable UI/SEO/schema/API/RBAC requirements are complete before Done.
Dependency classes and blocking semantics are preserved; a blocked dependency cannot be marked GREEN because another batch succeeded.
Parallel work requires satisfied dependencies, mutable-authority isolation, separate evidence boundaries and safe rollback/checkpointing.

No legacy migration replay as clean-build strategy; no client payment confirmation; no payment→Award; no completion→Award; no Session→official LP; no analytics mutation; no provider-secret exposure; no unsupported runtime/production claims.
Historical Blueprint/AEP material is precedent only; current W4 6.18–6.29 contracts supersede stale implementation specifics.

Carry architecture-first implementation, reusable components, server-side security, provider isolation, idempotency, state-machine enforcement, negative testing, evidence/checkpoints and rollback/containment; create no new semantic authority/Owner decision/runtime authorization.
